preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of queries is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of edges is exactly N-1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the range [1, N].
The array A has exactly N elements.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for x in A)
preconditions.description: Each element in array A is between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= N and (x == 1 or x == 2) for v, x in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query starts with either 1 or 2, and v is between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for v, x in queries if queries[queries.index((v, x))][0] == 1)
preconditions.description: For update queries, the new value x is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= result < 10**9 + 7 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result of a query type 2 is between 0 and 10^9 + 6.

postconditions.expression: len(results) == sum(1 for v, x in queries if x == 2)
postconditions.description: The number of results matches the number of query type 2.
